## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run validate` shows no errors.
- [ ] Ids are lowercase with hyphens, and file names match the ids.
- [ ] I did not change the id of an existing operator, weapon or gadget (renames change `name` only).
- [ ] New icons are SVG (preferred) or PNG/WebP of at least 256 × 256 px, square, with a transparent background.
- [ ] Icons are my own work or may be shared under the repository's terms (see LICENSE).
- [ ] I did not edit `dist/`, `schema/` or `scripts/` (or I explained why above).
- [ ] Translations (de, fr, lb) added where I know the game's wording. Optional; English is enough.
